import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Define grid for subplots
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Top products by total revenue (bar chart)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
bars = ax1.bar(range(len(product_revenue)), product_revenue.values, color=sns.color_palette('husl', len(product_revenue)))
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Products by Revenue', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax1.set_xticks(range(len(product_revenue)))
ax1.set_xticklabels(product_revenue.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
# Add value labels on bars
for i, (bar, value) in enumerate(zip(bars, product_revenue.values)):
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + max(product_revenue.values)*0.01,
             f'${value:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# 2. Sales distribution by age group (pie chart)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
age_group_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(age_group_sales)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_group_sales.values, labels=age_group_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                    colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Revenue Distribution by Age Group', fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Average transaction value by payment method (bar chart)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
payment_avg = df.groupby('payment_method')['total'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars3 = ax3.bar(range(len(payment_avg)), payment_avg.values, color=['#2E86AB', '#A23B72', '#F18F01'])
ax3.set_title('Average Transaction by Payment Method', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Payment Method')
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Transaction ($)')
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(payment_avg)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(payment_avg.index)
# Add value labels
for i, (bar, value) in enumerate(zip(bars3, payment_avg.values)):
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + max(payment_avg.values)*0.01,
             f'${value:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in revenue comparison (grouped bar chart)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :2])
takeaway_data = df.groupby(['is_takeaway', 'customer_age_group'])['total'].sum().unstack()
takeaway_data.index = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
takeaway_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=sns.color_palette('husl', len(takeaway_data.columns)))
ax4.set_title('Revenue: Takeaway vs Dine-in by Age Group', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Service Type')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax4.legend(title='Age Group', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 5. Price distribution by product size (box plot)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='size', y='price', order=size_order, ax=ax5, palette='viridis')
ax5.set_title('Price Distribution by Product Size', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Size')
ax5.set_ylabel('Price ($)')

# 6. Sales trend by hour of day (line chart)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax6.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=6, color='#2E86AB')
ax6.fill_between(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, alpha=0.2, color='#2E86AB')
ax6.set_title('Hourly Sales Trend', fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax6.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
# Annotate peak hour
peak_hour = hourly_sales.idxmax()
peak_value = hourly_sales.max()
ax6.annotate(f'Peak: Hour {peak_hour}\n${peak_value:,.0f}', 
             xy=(peak_hour, peak_value), 
             xytext=(peak_hour+2, peak_value*0.9),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='red'),
             fontweight='bold',
             color='red')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
